executor: Automated local harness run by the coding assistant
scope: Functional experiments using fictional, in-memory care data. No customer participation, medical validation or market testing.

results.hypothesis: The core follow-up works on Free.
results.procedure: Start one reminder, request help, and save a fictional outcome.

results.hypothesis: A Plus report includes the entered outcome.
results.procedure: Confirm Free report gating, simulate Plus, then generate a report.

results.hypothesis: Failure, cancellation and duplicate checkout preserve account state.
results.procedure: Attempt failure and cancel, then complete the same order twice.

results.hypothesis: Annual totals match the confirmed catalogue.
results.procedure: Activate each paid annual plan in a fresh fixture.

results.hypothesis: AI limits cannot prevent the basic care response.
results.procedure: Consume Plus allowance, reject an extra generation, then record a check-in.

results.hypothesis: Pro backup and handover update responsibility.
results.procedure: Configure 10/25-minute rules, advance 25 minutes, then hand back with a note.

results.hypothesis: Downgrade preserves records and current-cycle usage.
results.procedure: Generate one result, downgrade, then record an outcome.

results.hypothesis: Earlier open work remains visible in a seven-day report.
results.procedure: Leave one reminder open and advance eight demo days.

results.hypothesis: A new outcome on an old reminder counts in the current period.
results.procedure: Resolve the eight-day-old reminder and inspect one-day activity.

results.hypothesis: Care reset preserves outreach and unsent request records.
results.procedure: Use one in-memory synthetic outreach fixture and one request, then reset care.

results.hypothesis: Cross-midnight scheduling uses the due-date rota.
results.procedure: Set a dated rota and evening reminder, then advance 24 hours.

results.hypothesis: Invalid backup data cannot create a charged demo order.
results.procedure: Tamper with actualCharge on a simulated receipt and validate.
